name: Broadcast
description: Represents a Windows Live Broadcast Service broadcast session.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Broadcast object.

properties.name: AttendeeUrl
properties.description: If a broadcast is in progress, returns a String that represents the URL of the attendee link. Read-only.

properties.name: State
properties.description: Returns an MSOBroadcastState constant that describes the current broadcast state. Read-only.

properties.name: Capabilities
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the capabilities of the specified broadcast. Read-only.

properties.name: PresenterServiceUrl
properties.description: If a broadcast is in progress, returns a String that represents the URL of the presenter service hosting the broadcast. Read-only.

properties.name: SessionID
properties.description: If a broadcast is in progress, returns a String that specifies the ID of the session. Read-only.

parameters.name: serverUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the broadcast server.

methods.name: AddMeetingNotes
methods.signature: AddMeetingNotes(notesUrl As String, notesWacUrl As String)
methods.description: Adds shared meeting notes for the specified broadcast that are accessible to attendees who use either Microsoft OneNote 2013 rich client or web app.

parameters.name: notesUrl
parameters.description: Specifies the URL where the shared meeting notes are stored, for attendees using the Microsoft OneNote 2013 rich client.

parameters.name: notesWacUrl
parameters.description: Specifies the URL where the shared meeting notes are stored, for attendees using the Microsoft OneNote 2013 web access client.
